name: Rufous-backed Cellophane Bee
desc: Rufous-backed Cellophane Bee (Colletes thoracicus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 94 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Colletes thoracicus, the rufous-chested cellophane bee, is a species of cellophane or plasterer, masked, or fork-tongued bee in the family Colletidae. It is found in North America.
